full_prompt_en: A square documentary photograph shows a large geometric wall installation in a bright, empty gallery corner. The back wall is white and marked by a pale, regular gray grid whose thin horizontal and vertical lines cover a large rectangle. Within and beyond the grid, thick red, bright blue, and charcoal bands make a sequence of rising horizontal and curved forms. At the lower left, a solid blue vertical strip climbs from the dark floor and turns right into a long level bar. A short black bar sits inside it near the left. Midway across the wall, the blue bar bends upward into a dark gray section and continues to the right. Below it, a broad red stripe begins low on the left, rises in a smooth arc through the center, and finishes near the right side. A second red form starts near the upper right and curves upward toward the top edge. Small pale gray fragments interrupt the grid near the upper left, and a fine pink-red border runs around parts of the gridded rectangle. The wall meets a black baseboard above a glossy dark gray floor that reflects the lower blue band faintly. At the right edge, tall industrial windows with black metal mullions bring cool daylight into the room. Exposed white pipes and a long fluorescent light cross the high ceiling. A narrow yellow line lies along the floor near the lower right wall. The viewpoint is slightly angled into the corner, so the grid remains nearly frontal while the window wall recedes. Illumination is even from the window and ceiling light, producing soft floor reflections and no dramatic cast shadow. The painted bands have crisp, opaque edges against the matte white wall; the photograph retains fine architectural detail without people or readable words. The overall composition is spare and dynamic, using strong red-blue curves and a measured grid to animate an otherwise quiet industrial interior.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形纪实照片呈现一处明亮、空旷的画廊角落，后墙上有巨大的几何图形装置。后墙为白色，带浅灰色规则方格；纤细横线与竖线覆盖一片大矩形。在方格之内及之外，粗红、亮蓝和炭灰色带组成一组水平延伸与上升弯曲的形态。左下方，一条实心蓝色竖带从深色地板升起，随后向右转为一条长水平带。靠左侧，其内部有一条短黑带。墙面中段，蓝带向上折成深灰段，并继续向右延伸。下方一条宽红色条纹从左下起步，经中央平滑上升，终止于右侧附近。第二个红色形态从右上附近开始，向顶缘上弯。几块浅灰色碎片在左上附近打断方格，一道细粉红边框沿格子矩形部分边缘延伸。墙面在黑色踢脚线处与光亮深灰地板相接，地板微微反射下部蓝带。右缘高高的工业窗由黑色金属窗棂分格，把冷日光送入室内。裸露白管和一盏长荧光灯横过高天花板。右下墙边地板上有一道窄黄色线。视点略斜向角落，使方格几乎正面，而窗墙向后退。光从窗户及顶灯均匀照来，形成柔和地面反射，没有戏剧性投影。绘出的色带以清晰、不透明边缘对照哑光白墙；照片保留细密建筑细节，没有人物或可读文字。整体构图疏朗而富于动势，以强烈红蓝曲线和有节制的方格激活原本安静的工业室内。
style_prompt_en: The graphic treatment sets crisp opaque bands of primary red and blue against a largely white and pale-gray field. Thin, evenly spaced grid lines establish measured intervals, while heavy bars bend, rise, and arc across them with abrupt changes of direction. Charcoal segments and very small yellow accents create intermediate and peripheral counterpoints. Large clean negative areas keep the bold color from filling the entire frame. Edges are exact and flat, without brush texture inside the saturated shapes; surrounding neutral surfaces may retain slight grain and gentle reflected light. The visual energy comes from contrast between modular repetition and sweeping curves, and between thick colored strokes and hairline structure. Broad even illumination preserves color clarity and soft secondary reflections. The overall effect is economical and assertive, with spatial rhythm generated by scale, geometry, and sharply limited color.
style_prompt_zh: 图形化处理把边缘锐利、不透明的原色红蓝色带置于大面积白色及浅灰色域之中。纤细而等距的方格线建立有节制的间隔，粗重色带在其上折弯、上升并划出弧线，方向突然转换。炭灰色段和很小的黄色重音形成中间及外围的呼应。宽阔干净负空间让大胆色彩不至于填满整幅画。高饱和形体内部边缘精确平坦，没有笔触肌理；周围中性表面可保留轻微颗粒与柔和反光。视觉能量来自模块化重复与飞扬曲线、厚重彩色笔画与发丝般细结构之间的反差。宽阔均匀的照明保持色彩清晰和柔软次级反射。整体效果节省而鲜明，空间节奏由尺度、几何和严格受限的色彩生成。
theme_en: Bold red and blue graphic bands across a gridded gallery wall
theme_zh: 画廊方格墙面上的红蓝粗线图形
name: Lawrence Weiner
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
